statuses.native-verified: Observed on a live Protect controller; see the per-version live results. Applies only to those versions and conditions.

statuses.unsupported: Not provided by this build. The per-feature rejection field describes whether it is rejected, disabled, empty, ignored or simply unavailable.
statuses.needs_evidence: The native contract or behavior is not established; nothing may be claimed.

features.title: Private terminal-job tombstones keep duplicate protection while bounding the active journal

features.notes: Continuous mode moves terminal records older than 24 hours to private hash-only tombstones at startup or the next admission. contradictions.statement: Several records name Protect 7.3.56 as the target, while issue #2, PLAN.md and the caption trial use 7.3.60. No controller package for either 7.3.56 or 7.3.60 was inspected; static evidence is from 7.2.105.
contradictions.resolution: Manifest records results per version. Neither live version is a static reference.

contradictions.statement: Earlier docs/device-contract.md text said native camera descriptions and persistence were unverified; later Protect 7.3.60 trials recorded one on-demand description and two automatic captions on distinct camera families after page reload.
contradictions.resolution: The device contract now separates the earlier adoption evidence from the later caption acceptance record.

contradictions.statement: adoption-evidence.md says acceptance by an unmodified running controller remains needs_evidence; native adoption was later observed on 7.3.56.
contradictions.resolution: The static record is dated and version-scoped; the live 7.3.56 source supersedes it for adoption only.

contradictions.statement: worker-contract.md says MP4 export adaptation has not been tested against 7.3.56; README.md says 7.3.60 accepted it for the on-demand job.
contradictions.resolution: Both can be true. Recorded as native-verified on 7.3.60 only.

contradictions.statement: AI Key 2.2.8's description-only sender omits cameraId; the Protect 7.2.105 description-only schema requires it.
contradictions.resolution: Kept as two explicit callback profiles. Runtime rejection by the middleware was never exercised.

contradictions.statement: AI Key 2.2.8 NL_PARSE returns 768-value CLIP embeddings and has no /describe route; Protect 7.2.105 session search requests multilingual-e5-small and rejects non-384 vectors.
contradictions.resolution: The two packages are not a confirmed matched pair. Search status stays needs_evidence pending issue #10.

contradictions.statement: The 7.2.105 verifier accepts only ucp4 or updates as the requested subprotocol, but the live 7.3.56 frontend returned no selected subprotocol, so the strict ucp4 profile would fail there.
contradictions.resolution: Separate device-service profile, verified on 7.3.56 with a required pin.

contradictions.statement: An inference-gateway comment calls the device certificate NVR-issued; syswrapper.sh generates a self-signed RSA-2048 certificate.
contradictions.resolution: The generation code is treated as evidence; the comment is not.

contradictions.statement: The AI Key FAQ lists 1,000 detections per hour; the technical specifications list 1,800.
contradictions.resolution: No throughput claim is made. Measure actual behavior.

contradictions.statement: Audio eligibility differs between the AI Key FAQ and the camera capability guide.
contradictions.resolution: Audio is unsupported; eligibility needs evidence per camera.

contradictions.statement: lab-results.json reports native_protect_7_3_56 as needs_evidence although native adoption was observed on 7.3.56. The field describes the synthetic lab run, not project evidence.
contradictions.resolution: Treat lab output as synthetic only. The lab's schema is outside this issue.

contradictions.statement: Protect 7.2.105 fills missing capability flags with enabled values, so an absent flag reads as support.
contradictions.resolution: Unsupported capabilities are sent explicitly disabled. A capability flag is never treated as evidence.

remaining_native_tests.procedure: On the adopted test processor, read device health after connection and record compatibility.controller_version_evidence plus the setConsoleInfo result code from control_commands. Confirm whether 7.3.60 sends only the four allowlisted controller fields.
Record the capability state Protect shows for the processor, and the exact device.feature_flags in effect, before any caption trial.
Record adoption state before and after an in-place Protect upgrade; confirm reconnect without re-adoption.
Fresh adoption of a separately identified test processor on 7.3.60, including rotation and planned restart.
Only if a malformed or unsupported command occurs naturally: record the close or error code and whether Protect retries. Do not inject traffic into the production controller.

Repeat the persisted-caption check after a controller restart with a new reviewed permit. The second camera-family check passed on G4 Instant by native panel and full page reload; an exact-event GET remains open for that family.
Issue #10: determine whether 7.3.60 dispatches /describe and which search path it uses, before any search trial.
Interrupt the network path briefly and record reconnect timing and adoption state.

In an isolated, reviewed rollout, confirm fresh model-family inventory, Protect-side dispatch, persistence, budget exhaustion, additions/removals, reconnect and journal rollover. Keep richer native-AI models excluded until tag preservation is verified.
